'''K33 Division''' was a missile combat unit in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Army]]. It was one of the primary combatants during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] and throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
K33 Division supplied numerous units in a wide variety of roles. However, it set itself apart from other droid divisions in that its droids utilized enhanced self-aware programming along with upgraded artillery and torpedo systems to crush enemies from range. The various unit types included [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|''Persuader''-class]] droids, [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire''-class droids]], [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] often working in conjunction with the division's [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]]. [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] operated both [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] during battles to harass enemy troops. All units working together combined into a force that was considerably formidable.

The K33 Division employed a modified version of the Hailfire droid with heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] blasters, and moderate defensive enhancements. Toward the end of the Clone Wars, K33 Division was also provided with [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|tri-droids]] known for ripping apart both infantry and vehicles with ease.<ref>{{WizKids|url=starwars/cwtpreview.php|text=Clone Wars Tactics Preview}}</ref> For the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], K33 added [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP gunships]] to the division in their assault on [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].
